question: Can upstream characteristic records predict held-out local clock reception, including local interaction markers and pulse overlap?

method.action: SS OCF 1 flat action, U=s-s²+s³, V=0.25-0.4s+0.2s², zeta=0.1. Neutral response extension Z=1+0.2s (M0=m=1); same underlying action, separate registered active-neutral sector.
method.units: c=hbar=m=1; r,t in m^-1; fields in m; frequencies in m; dimensionless tick shift Omega*delta_t/(2*pi).
method.domain: R=80 at h=.1,.05,.025; R=160 at h=.1. Frozen profiles/modes; h=.025 interpolates frozen .05 calibration. Local probe r=.1; upstream R_s=14.
method.boundaries: Regular origin and zero radial fields at finite R. Longevity uses original logged sponge beyond r=60. Response uses no sponge; earliest outer reflection cannot reach core by t=100.
method.initial_data: Frozen omega_Q=.9 and Omega=.41274991, clock peak .001, phases 0 and pi/3. Two compact b=r*a pulses centered 18 and 26, width3, coefficient A=.002,.004,.008 and negative nominal. Both start exterior to the upstream sphere. First reflected pulse meets second inward pulse around r=4. Regular-origin reflection, not an independently prepared inner shell or two distant beams.
method.solver: Unchanged discrete reciprocal Hamiltonian and RK4; dt=.02,.01,.005 plus independent .01 at h=.1. Surface acquisition: first-order neutral field on frozen core, records a,a_t,a_r at R_s through t55, no interior histories. Reconstruct I=(R_s*a_t+a+R_s*a_r)/2=F_prime on t0..16, integrate cubic spline with F(0)=0 and linear endpoint-closure correction, set b(r,0)=F(r-R_s), b_t=F_prime. Vacuum exterior is an explicit approximation. Evolve full time-dependent Taylor response on matched evolving quiet background; no adiabatic approximation, no fit. Save all predictions before ANY nonlinear receiver evolution. Sample local fields/derivatives .1, spatial fields every1.
method.tolerances: Direct difference error budgets; no Richardson extrapolation. Cycle floor1e-11, field floor1e-13. Local markers first rising and last falling |a|=1e-4 in local acquisition t0..100. Local phase theta=unwrap atan2(-chi_dot/Omega,chi). delta_N is pulse minus quiet phase accumulated between those events divided by2pi. Quiet evaluated at the same marker proper times is explicitly counterfactual, no quiet reception claimed. Forecast both marker times and phase before nonlinear evolution; compare standalone interval forecasts. Frozen-core response is also executed. See locked inequalities.

hypotheses.prediction: The frozen calibration survives full refined longevity and predicts an even, amplitude-squared local response within registered error controls.
Unstable clock, sign-odd response, persistent prediction residual or ambiguous local ticks invalidates the tested approximation.

controls.purpose: Prevent calibration retuning and interior information leakage
controls.method: Frozen hashes; predictor consumes only surface records and quiet calibration; prediction locks precede receiver-start events.

controls.purpose: Bound grid, integration, boundary and small-record errors
controls.method: h=.1,.05,.025; independent dt/2 and R*2; direct differences plus absolute noise floors.

controls.purpose: Separate quadratic forcing, overlap and clock phase dependence
controls.method: Quiet, each pulse, both pulses, +/-A, A/2,A,2A; pi/3 clock phase and its quiet baseline; executed frozen-core replay.
